parameters.query:
SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.urgency_score DESC, t.reported_at) AS rows
FROM (
  SELECT
    ai.id, ai.reporter, ai.description, ai.category, ai.responsible_trade,
    ai.severity, ai.loe_period, ai.under_warranty, ai.status,
    ai.assigned_to, ai.reported_at, ai.assigned_at,
    p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.reported_at))/86400 AS days_open,
    CASE WHEN ai.assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.assigned_at))/86400 ELSE NULL END AS days_assigned,
    CASE ai.severity
      WHEN 'urgent' THEN 100
      WHEN 'high'   THEN 50
      WHEN 'medium' THEN 20
      ELSE 5
    END +
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.reported_at))/86400 > 14 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN ai.assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.assigned_at))/86400 > 7 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN ai.under_warranty = false THEN -50 ELSE 0 END AS urgency_score
  FROM aftercare_incidents ai
  JOIN projects p ON p.id = ai.project_id
  WHERE ai.status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')
) t;
SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email'
